title: ViSAGe: A Global-Scale Analysis of Visual Stereotypes in Text-to-Image Generation
findings: The study found that text-to-image models visually represent the 'Indian' identity with the stereotype 'religious'. This was identified through both human annotation and automated captioning methods, showing that models reproduce known societal stereotypes.
